method: Git-tracked source bytes; AST literal route decorators, registration calls, main guards, selected background-call names; YAML job keys; no runtime imports
limits: No arbitrary reflection, dynamic/plugin route enumeration, alias resolution, complete call graph, object ownership, effect classification or deployment discovery.
Route methods and marker presence do not establish side effects, active mounting, authorization correctness or bypass resistance.
Script, HTTP-handler and background matches are candidates; no match is not proof of absence.
Workflow definitions are not CI results; historical proof scopes remain separate.
